title: Screener in dev
author: Dev-Screen
selftext:
So I built a free momentum stock screener that runs a live composite score on every ticker. float size, relative volume, short squeeze setup, SEC dilution warnings, and catalyst signals all rolled into one grade.

It also has a public prediction track record at /track-record. every call it makes gets logged and resolved after 3 trading days so you can see the actual win rate, not just backtested curves.

Would love feedback especially on the scoring, false positives, and anything the screener misses that you think matters. 

“MonScreener” in search bar.
